title: Persona declaration, plugins/<persona>/persona.json (ADR-0066 Decision 2)
description: Stage 1 fields: identity, the deliverable noun, the runtime footer floor, the capabilities and the decide data. Profiles, verb parameters, artifact templates and peer policy arrive in Stage 2 with a minor format bump. Cross-field rules the schema cannot state (the decide fallback equals the registry preset, profile_presets needs its map, tie_break names a fallback axis, each enrolled unit's fields are present) are checked by scripts/sync-persona-pipeline.mjs. Validated with the closed keyword subset of plugins/runtime/scripts/lib/schema-validate.mjs.

name.description: The persona name; equals the plugin directory and the plugin manifests' name. The state directory, command prefix, re-injection marker, peer-run handle and self-sensor source are derived from it.

deliverable_noun.description: The deliverable as user-facing messages name it, e.g. 'business deliverable' (V2).

runtime_footer_floor.description: The oldest runtime whose footer this persona accepts (V18).

capabilities.description: Every flag is required, so no capability reads as off by absence (ADR-0066 Decision 3).

fallback.description: The in-code fallback preset (V4); must equal the registry preset of the same id.

profile_presets.description: L4 profile -> preset id (V6); present exactly when capabilities.profile_presets is on.

tie_break.description: Axes ranked first when aggregates tie, in order (V8).
